svg.text: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o
ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
The three customers who placed the most orders are
Lakshmi Rao (14), Karthik Singh (11) and Nila Das (10).
Python · Ollama · sqlglot · SQLite · CSV import
